claim.value: Failure to locate approval evidence alone places a historical case in the unresolved category.
claim.scope: Classification based solely on an unsuccessful evidence search, without additional evidence of late or absent approval.

provenance.rationale: P017 explicitly assigns failure to locate evidence alone to the unresolved category.

signal_basis.value: Review of purchasing records, meeting minutes and delegated-authority forms fails to locate evidence establishing authorized approval before order placement, with no additional evidence establishing late or absent approval.
signal_basis.scope: Historical classification of an individual flagged order; an unsuccessful search alone does not establish that approval never occurred.

provenance.rationale: These spans specify the record review, the unsuccessful-search classification and the limitation on inferring absent approval.
No conditional empirical relation is needed for this supported classification.

rationale: An unsuccessful evidence search alone leaves prior approval undetermined. Classifying that case as unresolved accurately reflects this evidentiary limit without inferring that approval was absent.
uncertainty: Whether approval actually occurred remains unknown; that uncertainty warrants the unresolved classification.
